d:
Are you tired of waking up every hour to use the bathroom? Frequent urination at night (Nocturia) can be exhausting and stressful, making it impossible to get a good night's rest. In this video, Amit explains how your mind and emotions play a role in an overactive bladder and guides you through a powerful EFT (Emotional Freedom Technique) tapping session to help you find relief.
What you’ll learn in this session:
How to identify the emotional triggers of frequent urination.
A step-by-step EFT tapping sequence to calm your nervous system and bladder.
